column2: When I found you badly hurt and lying there, $$お兄ちゃん$$...
I was so scared I thought my heart would stop!
Really... I really cried until morning!
If $$お兄ちゃん$$ died, I couldn't live all alone...
As long as $$お兄ちゃん$$ is by my side, I don't need anything else!
For $$お兄ちゃん$$, I can do anything. Even if... even if it is something terribly bad...
